purpose: Chapter 5 turn-event handler (slot 1, dispatch idx 0x0F at table 0x51B91, fired turn 4 / phase 1): plays a scripted cutscene beat -- reset battle-anim phase, reload portrait set 2 as an init-phase load, pan camera, run cutscene 0x17, clear all character facing, disarm the AI/dialog control flag (low 4 bits of combat_aux_block[0xD]) across two character ranges, then show dialog page 4.

Sets data_fd2_battle_anim_phase=0; sets data_fd2_chapter_init_phase_flag=1, calls fd2_load_chapter_portraits_and_dump_tmp(2), sets the flag back to 0 (bracketing the reload as an init-phase load); fd2_pan_cursor_and_window(0xE,0); fd2_cutscene_event_trigger(0x17); fd2_clear_all_chars_facing(); fd2_set_combat_aux_block_byte_d_low4_for_char_range(7,0xC,0) and (0x21,0x23,0); finally fd2_display_dialog_scene(text, page=4, 0xA0000, 0x140, 0xCD, 0x4C, 0x4A, 0x13, 1). In the original binary the final dialog setup-and-call is a JMP into handler_09's shared tail at 0x34516 (page hardcoded 4); reproduced as an inline call for Layer-2 equivalence. __CHK(0x28) stack-probe prologue is compiler-injected. EBX is not touched.
